newsitem.title: YEMEN: Yemen deports 16,000 illegal aliens since Aug 95.
newsitem.headline: Yemen deports 16,000 illegal aliens since Aug 95.

text.p: Yemen has expelled more than 16,000 illegal aliens since it launched a crackdown on unlawful immigration in August 1995, a senior official said in remarks published on Friday.

Interior Minister Hussein Mohammad Arab, quoted by the weekly September 26, said "at least 16,000" foreigners living and working illegally in Yemen had been deported since the beginning of the campaign against illegal aliens, who are mostly from Somalia, Ethiopia and Eritrea.

"The operations are continuing...and the Interior Ministry is capable of finding and expelling those who do not respect law and order," Arab told the magazine, which is the official organ of the Yemeni armed forces.
Yemen, a small oil producer, is one of the poorest Arab countries and suffers from about 25 percent unemployment.
